title: Fresh at Decision, Stale at Action: Routing New Information to LLM Decisions Already Made
abstract: arXiv:2610.18126v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Freshness shapes an LLM decision at the moment it is made; the action it commits to is latent, carried out later, in a changing world. We therefore introduce a timestamp theory of decision validity and a decision ledger that realises it. Six timestamps define a decision; a freshness ceiling bounds what up-to-date evidence guarantees at action time, placing the remaining risk in information published afterwards. Accuracy then factorises into two capabilities: routing, which delivers that information to affected decisions before their revision deadlines, and temporal judgment, which reads it for the time of action. The ledger is persistent state holding each decision's times, evidence and background knowledge, indexed by watch conditions written at decision time. Controlled decision streams with exact labels confirm four predictions across five LLMs, from 8B to frontier scale: freshness alone yields exactly the accuracy the ceiling predict

translated_title: 决策时新鲜，行动时过时：将新信息路由至已做出的LLM决策
translated_abstract: 新鲜度在决策做出的那一刻塑造LLM的决策；而它所承诺的行动却是潜在的，会在之后不断变化的世界中执行。因此，我们提出了一种决策有效性的时间戳理论，以及实现该理论的决策账本。六个时间戳定义一个决策；新鲜度上限限定了最新证据在行动时所能保证的范围，将其余风险归于事后发布的信息。准确率由此分解为两种能力：路由——在受影响决策的修订期限之前将相关信息送达；以及时间判断——在行动时刻正确解读该信息。该账本是持久化状态，保存每个决策的时间、证据和背景知识，并以决策时写下的监视条件为索引进行索引。带有精确标签的可控决策流在五个LLM（从8B到前沿规模）上验证了四项预测：仅凭新鲜度只能达到新鲜度上限所预测的准确率。
tldr: 该论文提出决策有效性的时间戳理论与决策账本框架，将LLM决策准确率分解为两种能力——在修订期限前将事后发布的新信息“路由”到已做出的受影响决策，以及在行动时刻进行“时间判断”，并通过五个不同规模LLM的受控实验验证了新鲜度上限等四项预测。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces a timestamp theory of decision validity and a decision ledger that factorizes LLM decision accuracy into routing newly published information to already-made decisions before their revision deadlines and temporal judgment at action time, validated by controlled experiments across five LLMs from 8B to frontier scale.
